Our Project Plan is structured to deliver the full 64 km rehabilitation/widening scope and three RCC bridge reconstructions within the Employer’s 24‑month construction period, explicitly planning around two monsoon seasons through front-loaded earthworks, staged diversions, and protection works.

Phase 1 (Month 1–2): Mobilization and baseline planning—site establishment, traffic management setup, surveys, utility coordination, and CPM baseline submission. We will staff the project with a PMP-led planning function consistent with our in-house PMP-certified project managers capacity [CO-PROFILE].

Phase 2 (Month 2–6): Early works and enabling packages—earthworks in priority reaches, temporary diversions/culverts, and drainage outfalls to keep the corridor serviceable during rains. Our road delivery pacing is anchored on prior road construction deployments completed in 7–8 months for comparable execution packages [CAP-015][CAP-039].

Phase 3 (Month 3–18): Mainline pavement and structures in parallel—subgrade improvement, granular layers, asphalt works, retaining structures, and road safety furniture concurrent with bridge substructure/superstructure works to maintain critical path control.

Phase 4 (Month 6–22): Bridge construction completion and approaches—bridge works will follow a dedicated structure schedule anchored on our bridge engineering delivery experience (13–24 month deployments) [CAP-040][CAP-004], with approaches tied to pavement milestones.

Phase 5 (Month 22–24): Finishing, testing, and handover—punch list closure, as-builts, and demobilization.

Our library does not yet evidence completion of a ≥60 m span bridge as prime contractor; we will address this requirement through a qualified bridge construction partner while retaining overall program control and quality governance under our ISO 9001-aligned practices evidenced on prior road delivery [CAP-039][CO-PROFILE]. Our library also does not yet evidence ownership/access to an asphalt plant, batching plant, and crusher within 50 km; we will secure assured access via pre-award leasing/partner MOUs and submit the supporting commitments with the work program.
